title: Closed immersion on small etale sheaves of sets
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] and $j:U=X\setminus i(Z)\hookrightarrow X$ its complementary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. On the small etale topoi [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the direct image $i_*:\operatorname{Sh}(Z_{\mathrm{Et}})\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{Et}})$ on sheaves of sets is fully faithful, and its essential image consists exactly of the sheaves $F$ whose restriction $j^{-1}F$ is the terminal sheaf on $U_{\mathrm{Et}}$. The counit $i^{-1}i_*\to\operatorname{id}$ is an isomorphism. Here inverse and direct image are the geometric-morphism adjoints [def-trf-geometric-morphism].

source.place: Tag 04CA, proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward, part (1) and final assertion (sheaves of sets, not only abelian sheaves).
